items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: he was in it and his son Chris was a king.

ctx.x: And that’s when I met Dave and fortunately we had been in touch because I used one of his songs in the jazz nativity and he was in it and his son Chris was a king.
Oh. Chris was a king. Was it “God’s Love Made Visible” that you used?
